gpuhint.copied: Copied. Paste it into the address bar of a new tab and press Enter.
gpuhint.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it.
gpuhint.cost: The faster card uses more power: on battery the laptop runs for a shorter time and gets warmer. To undo, choose Disabled again in the browser, or in Windows the option that lets Windows decide.
gpuhint.fixFlag: Fastest, in the browser: open this address in a new tab, choose Enabled, then press {button}:
gpuhint.fixWindows: In Windows: open the graphics settings (Settings, System, Display, Graphics), add this browser to the list if it is not there, choose High performance for it, then close the browser completely and start it again. If nothing changes, restart the computer.
gpuhint.softFixBrowser: Graphics acceleration may be switched off in the browser. Open this address in a new tab, switch graphics (hardware) acceleration on, and restart the browser:
gpuhint.softFixDriver: The graphics driver may be disabled or missing, so the browser has no graphics card to draw on.
gpuhint.softFixDriverWindows: In Windows open Device Manager, Display adapters: every adapter must be enabled and have a driver installed. On a laptop a disabled integrated chip (Intel) can leave the browser with no graphics card at all, even when there is an NVIDIA card: enable the Intel adapter again.
gpuhint.softText: The browser is drawing this page in software ({name}): on the processor, not on a graphics card, so everything here runs very slowly. This usually has one of two causes:
gpuhint.text: The browser is drawing this page on the integrated graphics chip ({name}). If this computer also has an NVIDIA or AMD graphics card, the browser is not using it: on Windows the browser, not the page, picks the card, and it ignores the page's request for the faster one. To switch:
gpuhint.textBack: The browser is drawing this page on the integrated graphics chip ({name}) again. Earlier this browser drew on a faster graphics card. To switch back:
gpuhint.warn.back: This browser drew on a faster graphics card before.
gpuhint.warn.software: The browser draws on the processor, not on a graphics card.
gpuhint.warn.switch: A faster graphics card may be sitting unused.
